# Ewave Order Images

[wiki link](https://wiki.ewave.com/display/LEGO/Order+Images)

### Version 1.0.0
The extension shows product images on order details, invoice, shipment, creditmemo, print, RMA pages.

#### Supported order pages:

 - items ordered (include print)
 - invoices (include print)
 - order shipments (include print)
 - refunds (include print)
 - RMA (include print)
 
 #### Developers info:
Default image type is "cart_page_product_thumbnail". You can change image type in layouts: "sales_order_product_images.xml" and "magento_rma_returns_view.xml".
